proof_scope: scillm#37 OpenCode serve terminal provider errors are preserved instead of masked as timeouts

claims.proves: A retained regression exercises the OpenCode serve timeout/result path and verifies assistant info.error ProviderAuthError is surfaced as provider_error/provider_auth_error, not timeout_before_terminal_sentinel.
claims.does_not_prove: Provider credentials are configured, Google calls succeed, the Ask README writer completes, or all OpenCode provider errors are semantically recoverable.

capability_claims.description: OpenCode serve preserves terminal provider errors from message snapshots instead of collapsing them into timeout results.
